name: settleup
description: No-login, private-by-link group expense splitter for one shared-cost event.
author: Andrejs Strazds <andrejs@astrazds.com>

scripts.pretest:smoke: npm run build:client && npm run db:migrations:apply:local
scripts.pretest:smoke:critical: npm run build:client && npm run db:migrations:apply:local
scripts.pretest:smoke:extended: npm run build:client && npm run db:migrations:apply:local
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run typecheck && npm run test:smoke && npm run validate:html && sh -c 'trap "rm -rf dist-dry-run" EXIT; npm run deploy:dry-run'

DB.description: Cloudflare D1 database for Events, Participants, Expenses, Shares, Settlement Payments, Balances, and Suggested Settlements. Wrangler config binds this as `DB` and migrations live in `migrations/`.

EVENT_REALTIME.description: Durable Object namespace for Event-scoped WebSocket fan-out. The class is `EventRealtimeRoom` and migrations create it with SQLite storage.

VERSION_METADATA.description: Worker version metadata used for deployment diagnostics and the `x-worker-version` response header.
